Franz confirmed that the legacy SFL_APP_PRIVATE_KEY and OPENROUTER_API_KEY entries with no references in the scanned default-branch workflows on the 42 identified transfer targets are unused by external clients.

Classify only those unreferenced legacy entries as owner-confirmed unused. Keep encrypted entries in place; no credential values need to be retrieved or tested for these unused dependencies. Actively referenced credentials in buddy-ios, hs-buddy and the SFL source, and unrelated dashboard/gh-x/reports/skills credentials, remain separate checks. This does not waive other mandatory pre-transfer gates or authorize a source/App transfer before they pass.

Machine-readable record of the same previously confirmed owner fact. This adds no new permission or scope.
